title: Tofu Princess Jump
description: Time crisp one-tap jumps to stack wobbly slices of silky tofu higher and higher beneath an adorable princess—nail center landings for golden combo boosts.
controls: Tap anywhere to make the princess leap straight onto each incoming tofu block and stack sky-high.

zh-CN.title: 豆腐公主
zh-CN.description: 微信爆款魔性一指跳跃豆腐公主：看准左右滑来的嫩豆腐一键起跳稳稳踩正中心，越堆越高解锁可爱公主皮肤！
zh-CN.controls: 在豆腐块滑入脚下的瞬间点击屏幕起跳稳稳踩住，连续踩中中心触发完美高分。
